note: Two-column verso body page, 1750x2180 px (ratio 0.803, not A4). body_text_size_px=20 (cap-to-baseline; body line pitch 35 px, green-box italic pitch 33 px hence size_rel 0.9). All nine A2 blocks placed. ONE UNCERTAINTY: block 5 is a single paragraph that runs across the column break -- its first five lines sit at the foot of the LEFT column and its last five lines ('these objects obey. When quantum mechanics is applied...') open the RIGHT column. I put n=5 on the left-column region and n=null on the right-column continuation region rather than repeat the same n twice, so a consumer does not render that text in both places; the null element is the tail of block 5, not an unmatched block. The Erwin Schroedinger box (n=1, green #cbe7d3) contains a portrait photograph and its two-line bold-italic caption, both emitted separately as unnumbered elements with the box's fill behind the caption. Heading n=3 ('2.6 QUANTUM MECHANICAL MODEL OF ATOM', two lines, cyan #00adef, all caps) is a numbered top-level section so I used major_heading; n=8 is a sub-heading so section_heading. Both are bold sans (n=8 italic); the allowed font list has no sans-italic so I report 'sans'. No page_header_band, rule_bar or footer_rule: furniture is the running head (STRUCTURE OF ATOM left, page number 53 right) and the centred '2024-25' footer line, labelled running_header because it is a running footer rather than the page number. A diagonal '(C) NCERT not to be republished' watermark crosses both columns; not emitted as an element.
